children: Japan and the U.S. are in talks over building a semiconductor factory as part of their $550B investment agreement, with the project estimated to cost ¥2T-¥3T ($12.9B-$19.3B),
The factory would be operated by GlobalFoundries
, the report said, citing unidentified officials from both countries.

Japan agreed last year to invest $550B in the U.S. as part of a deal to lower tariffs on Japanese exports. Besides, the two countries are also discussing other projects under the deal, including a large-scale data center involving the SoftBank Group

title: GlobalFoundries to run chip factory under Japan-U.S. investment deal - report
